items.title: Demons Inside
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Everyone has their little demons inside them! Embrace your little devious side! It might be fun!

+ 12 roleplay skins!
+ Devilish attire inspired by demons!

items.title: Mech Boss
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
A unit of unparalleled strength. A suit of technological genius and superior craftsmanship. Am absolute force to be reckoned with. The mech boss has arrived.

- 12 roleplay skins!
- Mechanical attire inspired by science fiction!

items.title: Cyberpunk
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
In the year 2055, humanity has taken many leaps and bounds into the future of technology, and our fashion surely shows it. Check out the latest flavors of life with these new outfits!

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Medieval, luxury attire!

items.title: Ivory Demons
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
White, ivory cream. A pure and clean texture. Nothing could be more cool and rich than ivory demons!

- 12 roleplay skins!
- Cute and casual attire inspired by white ivory!

items.title: Teens
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Teens need cool fashion when returning to school! Show off these modern skins with your friends and be stylish!

items.title: Summer Style
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Summer style is always in season! A teen fashion trend that never dies because it's full of color and stylish modern designs. Grab a new skin from this pack you can wear forever!

items.title: Millionaire Underground Base 2
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Live underground with everything you need to survive, protected from mobs and other dangers!

+ Lootings to survive
+ Amazing mansion
+ By 4KS Studios and Street Studios

items.title: Boss Fight
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Who’s the boss? You’re the boss! Choose from 8 super strong skins and become everyone’s top enemy. Look rough and tough as you role-play as a superboss or final boss. Use all your strategy and knowledge to beat whoever dares to challenge you. Get ready to battle!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Baby Birds
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Chirp and chirp, while looking super cute! Step out of the nest and role-play as an adorable baby bird. Choose from 12 colorful skins and learn how to fly across the sky or just to the next branch. Stay safe up there!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Cartoon Mobs
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
There’s lots of exciting, bright color to go around with these popular mobs. Role-play as your favorite passive, neutral or hostile, all in cartoon style. Choose from 12 different skins of the mobs you like the most, with a more happy, carefree look.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Lucky Skyblock Biomes
items.creator: Diluvian
items.description: With massive lucky blocks floating around it’s just a point of when we will have luck and diamonds will pop out of nowhere. But stay safe and avoid spawning creepers that will destroy your cute little home!

items.title: Trendy Teens
items.creator: DogHouse
items.description:
Still searching for the perfect outfit? Then this is your chance!
Choose one of the 12 trendy skins and impress everybody.
-12 Skins
-Perfect for roleplay
-Have fun!

items.title: Autumn City Life
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
The weather is getting chilly and the leaves are falling. Autumn is here! Get cozy in scarves, sweaters, and hoodies while staying perfectly in style today!

- 8 Autumn Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Elegant Students
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Enjoy the student years and show off your elegant clothes!
Perfect for any time of the year, these skins provide you with the freshest fashion!

+ 12 skins, bringing the classy vibes to your worlds!
+ Gather your friends and let the teen fun begin!

items.title: Ultimate Neon Base
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Live in this Ultimate Neon Base and make your life like a futuristic person. Explore many amazing rooms and parts of this megabase. In this base you will find:

+ OP hacker tools
+ Automated XP farm
+ Automated mine
+ Futuristic laboratory
+ Lasers
+ 6 HD skins
+ Game room
+ Amazing neon particles
+ Huge farm
+ Licensed by Pixel Creations and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Submarine Secret Base
items.creator: A30x1
items.description: A long time ago a mysterious submarine got stuck, from time to time treasure hunters explore the area looking to find a hidden treasure. Some say there is a secret entrance somewhere, can you find it?

items.title: Stylish Misfits
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Put away your street fashion skins and bring out your inner misfit with these crazy and weird stylish looks! From plain and simple to detailed and mysterious there is something for everyone! Grab your favourite one and go out to your server or world and show it off to your friends! 

- 12 skins
- by inPixel

items.title: Ultimate One Block
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Skyblock is too easy for you? Then try your hand at the One Block Challenge! 
Whenever you mine the block you get a random item or block!
Build from island to island and think carefully about how to use the few resources.

items.title: Space Demons
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
We're too far out; there's no going back. Just the life of a Space Demon!

-Spooky Demon Style Skins
-Roleplay with Friends

items.title: Volcano Parkour
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Caution! Unless you want to fall into a magma pit... play Volcano Parkour! Embark on a wild and dangerous parkour adventure in a volcano. Will you triumph? 

* Multiplayer Supportive!
* Magma Themed!
* Perfect for the experiences parkour player!

items.title: Demon Mansion Escape Rooms
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Are you ready to get spooked? Try and free yourself from these demon rooms inside of a mansion by finding buttons! Can you make it out alive? Are you a noob or a pro? Well, find out!

* Hardcore & Spooky
* Multiplayer Supportive!
* Great map to play with your high school friends!

items.title: Love Droppers
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Love is in the air from Giggle Block Studios! It's time for a classic Dropper map! But with *LOVE*! Explore the 14 unique sky-high levels!

* Multiplayer Compatible, perfect for 2 ;)
* Try and complete all 14 droppers!
By Giggle Block Studios

items.title: Teen Hoodie Fashion
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
It's about time we got some more fashion in this world! Introducing Teen Hoodie Fashion! A carefully curated combination of all the best parts of skins! Bring roleplaying to the next level!

* 20+ teenage hoodie skins!
* Sleek, clean designs!
* Modern unique theme for each skin!

items.title: Good & Evil
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
These silly angel and demon teen skins are ready for roleplay and fantasy adventures in any of your Minecraft worlds! 
* Perfect for enjoying your high school builds or city festivals!
